items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: Do you know about the one he’s doing on Monk?

ctx.x: I don’t know if this is a generalization but the British writers seem to take great pride in details and making things absolutely correct, and I think of Chris Sheridan and the book on Count Basie that is unbelievable.
Sure. Do you know about the one he’s doing on Monk?
